PURPOSE: Two problems, one mechanism:
1. Pagefind search index staleness bound: rebuilds index ≤1 week after
any publish (new entries become searchable within a week without a
manual deploy). Spec DL5.
2. Supabase free-tier auto-pause keep-alive: the build queries the store
in generateStaticParams, which counts as API activity and prevents
the project from being paused after 1 week of inactivity. Spec §4.4.
SETUP (once Vercel project is linked):
1. Vercel dashboard → Settings → Git → Deploy Hooks
Create hook: name='weekly-rebuild', branch='main'
Copy the hook URL (format: https://api.vercel.com/v1/integrations/deploy/...)
2. Store the URL as a repo secret (GitHub → Settings → Secrets):
name: VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL
3. The GitHub Actions cron at .github/workflows/weekly-rebuild.yml (created
by S8) fires the hook every Monday at 03:00 UTC.
4. PublishPanel REINDEX button fires the same hook on demand for publishes
that need immediate searchability (spec §8.6).
